summary.text: Jean Anglade is a New York entrepreneur who ran as a write-in candidate for Mayor of New York City in 2025 and is running a write-in campaign for governor as an independent. In his 2025 Ballotpedia survey he described himself as focused on lowering the cost of living, police accountability and affordable housing.

paragraphs.text: Anglade was born in New York and earned a high school diploma from Alif Muhammad Nia School. He works as an entrepreneur, including with Celebs123 Auto Tags, and is also listed as affiliated with Western Governors University.
In his 2025 Ballotpedia survey, he described his first job as a caregiver, which he held for one year, and said he was pursuing a degree at Western Governors University.
Anglade ran as an independent write-in candidate in the 2025 general election for Mayor of New York City, which was won by Zohran Mamdani; Ballotpedia lists him with 3 votes.
